slides.audience_takeaway: Know who the team is and be able to repeat the selected idea in one sentence.

visual.composition: Team details and one plain sentence; mark missing name, number and mechanism as blocked.

speaker_notes: Timing: 20 seconds.
Do not substitute a polished slogan for the missing mechanism.

slides.claim: When did you last receive something made deliberately to show appreciation?
slides.audience_takeaway: Recall the emotional difference between receiving a deliberate object and an ordinary message.

visual.composition: One question plus an empty evidence slot for a consented real letter or care-package object.

speaker_notes: Timing: 30 seconds.
Use one real team-owned story only with consent; no invented persona or quote.
Transition: why does this feel unusual on an ordinary day?

slides.claim: Why can “I appreciate you” feel natural on a birthday, but sound like goodbye on an ordinary Tuesday?
slides.audience_takeaway: Understand the hypothesised unwritten rule without mistaking it for a universal fact.

visual.composition: The same sentence appears once, with birthday and ordinary-day context on opposite sides; label the frame as a hypothesis.

speaker_notes: Timing: 25 seconds.
Do not claim that all friends or all men share this reaction.
Transition: research gives us a narrower explanation for why people hold back.

slides.claim: We may hold back because we mispredict how appreciation will land.
slides.audience_takeaway: See the supported prediction gap and the unresolved risks around meaning, sincerity and pressure.

visual.composition: Two sourced findings and one explicit limitation; no decorative research collage.

speaker_notes: Timing: 30 seconds.
External gratitude research is directional evidence, not proof of this audience or medium.
Transition: that uncertainty changes what the experience must protect.

slides.claim: A care experience must preserve authorship without turning receipt into a debt.
slides.audience_takeaway: Understand the provisional requirements that follow from the sender and receiver evidence.

visual.composition: A direct finding-to-requirement mapping for authorship, interpretation, agency, closure and keeping.

speaker_notes: Timing: 25 seconds.
Keep requirements provisional until primary research is complete.
Transition: now make the medium prove it can satisfy those requirements.

slides.claim: The words stay the same. Does the container change what they mean?
slides.audience_takeaway: See ordinary chat, a physical or crafted control and a rough digital artefact compared fairly.

visual.composition: Three matched representations with identical wording and empty result fields for sincerity, awkwardness, ownership, alarm and reply pressure.

speaker_notes: Timing: 25 seconds.
Do not draw a speculative Goldilocks chart as if it were measured data.
Transition: the result, not preference, determines which direction earns the reveal.

slides.audience_takeaway: Understand the selected response and its distinct mechanism in one sentence.

visual.composition: Product name, one-line mechanism and one dominant product state after selection.

speaker_notes: Timing: 20 seconds.
A multimedia feature list is not a mechanism.

slides.audience_takeaway: See where the selected mechanism changes the unwritten rule from trigger to outcome.

visual.composition: Trigger, deliberate creation, bounded delivery, receiver-controlled opening and safe completion in one sequence.

speaker_notes: Timing: 35 seconds.
Label every simulated or proposed state.

motion.description: Only after the mechanism is selected; motion may reveal the causal sequence one state at a time.

slides.audience_takeaway: See why the sender acts now and what remains personally authored.

visual.composition: One sender path from trigger through deliberate authorship; no feature tour.

speaker_notes: Timing: 35 seconds.
Show that AI does not write the intimate content.

motion.description: Use only if it clarifies interaction order or system response.

slides.audience_takeaway: See the receiver interpret, open, keep or close the experience without compulsory reciprocity.

visual.composition: One receiver path from arrival through opening and safe completion; concentrate any justified reveal here.

speaker_notes: Timing: 35 seconds.
A rich reveal must explain value, not substitute spectacle for evidence.

slides.audience_takeaway: Believe that the experience handles unwanted, mistaken, inaccessible or private moments safely.

visual.composition: The smallest set of real product states covering decline, delete, wrong recipient, privacy, reduced motion and no-device access.

speaker_notes: Timing: 30 seconds.
Do not describe safeguards that the prototype does not demonstrate.

slides.audience_takeaway: See one participant finding change the design and understand the remaining evidence boundary.

No invented quote, number, score or effect.
